svg.title: Job Discovery Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: Cloudflare Workflow orchestrating scraper plugins, LLM filtering, and D1 dedup across four steps

g.text: D1: SELECT latest Job Search Framework for user → pass to all downstream steps
Workflow.parallel() — one branch per registered scraper
Batched. Score each raw job against user framework. Drop clear mismatches.
D1: match by source_url index. Insert new only. status = Waiting for Human.
New jobs surface under "Jobs to review" at next digest send
